node.statement: Apply GT-kitaev-canonical-stinespring to Phi and use the same matrix-unit construction for the single full matrix algebra B(H): its finite-dimensional unital representation space is unitarily H tensor F for a finite-dimensional Hilbert space F, the representation is T->T tensor I_F, and the Stinespring isometry becomes V:H->H tensor F, giving Phi(T)=V^*(T tensor I_F)V.
